data.one_liner: Interactive Flutter architecture CLI for features and clean architecture code generation.
data.what_it_does: Cleany is an interactive CLI tool that scaffolds feature-based and clean architecture Flutter projects. It generates features, components, use cases, and routing using Cubit or Bloc, along with environment configuration and encrypted local storage.
use_when: You want to bootstrap a new Flutter project using a strict Clean Architecture pattern.
You want a CLI to interactively generate features, components, and use cases.
You want automated wiring of dependencies and routing for new features.
avoid_when: You prefer writing your own folder structures and boilerplate manually.
Your project does not follow Clean Architecture or use Cubit/Bloc.
strengths: Standardizes project structure and feature organization across a team.
Interactive terminal menu with recovery and self-healing doctor capabilities.
Automates boilerplate generation for data, domain, and presentation layers.
weaknesses: Enforces a specific architectural pattern that may not fit all applications.
Customizing generated templates beyond the CLI's options can be restrictive.
data.setup_notes: Run dart pub global activate cleany, then run cleany inside a Flutter project directory.
data.minimal_example:
flutter create playground
cd playground
cleany
